scope: Generic browser 3D viewport runtime. No domain geometry or engineering formulas.

capabilities.summary: WebGL renderer with pixel-ratio cap (2), soft shadow maps, ACES tone mapping, render-on-demand idle loop, resize observer, and full disposal.
Aspect-aware perspective fit of axis-aligned bounds with margin; pure math, unit tested.
Named view directions (isometric, front, side, top, underbody, rear) applied through fitBounds.
Pointer orbit, pan, zoom, tilt via OrbitControls plus keyboard equivalents (arrows, +/-, WASD, R, F).
Continuous frames only while an adapter animates; honors reduced motion by snapping camera transitions.
Raycaster picking from client coordinates; climbs to the nearest ancestor with userData.partId.
Straight-line distance between two points with unit conversion (m, mm, cm, in, ft).
Disposes geometries, materials, and textures reachable from an object.
React hook that owns runtime lifecycle for a canvas inside a sized container and reports WebGL failure.
